_comment: Phase-0 rename safety net — authoritative HKDF/domain-separation label classification. Generated by scanning derivePurposeKey/deriveNamespaceKey/direct hkdf() constant args + the master-rotation purpose registry on origin/main 2026-06-16. The code scan is authoritative; docs/hkdf-info-string-registry.md is reconciled against THIS file. server/test/structure/hkdf-registry-reconciliation.test.ts re-runs the scan and fails if an in-code label is missing here. Classes per Codebase_Professionalization_Scoping_2026-06-14.md §7: decryptable-store | non-decrypt-label | crypto-domain-label | wire-constant | cross-language-fixture.

_classes.decryptable-store: Encrypts a persisted store read back via decrypt(); gets a pre-change at-rest fixture that current code reads green.
_classes.crypto-domain-label: A MAC / key-wrap / signing-key derivation label (not a decryptable persisted store); gets a retained-constant assertion (frozen-surfaces guard) — renaming it breaks verification/unwrap of existing data.
_classes.wire-constant: Embedded in a frozen on-the-wire or external value; covered by the frozen-surfaces guard + wire snapshots.
_classes.cross-language-fixture: Crosses the TS<->other-language boundary; covered by a cross-language fixture/parity check.
